verdictSemantics.PASS: the recipe's actions executed (execution count > 0) and every expected outcome was met against live observation. This attests the DECLARED CONSTRUCTION SCOPE only: the same-engine maintenance-run linkage (origin_run, knowledge ids, operation key, receipt binding, RUN_ID_REQUIRED/CLOSURE_INVALID refusals, preserved delivery history with no second currentPhase), the new-authorization restoration gate (RESTORE_AUTHZ_NOT_NEW against pre-isolation licenses), the recorded and separately timed SLA (detect_target_seconds=180, isolate_target_seconds=120, end_to_end_target_seconds=300; fault-exposure window and alert delivery on two independent clocks with pausedMs=0) and the recipe/registration tracking. The complete previous journey (same-run-delivery steps 7-11) is never a construction prerequisite of this recipe, and no script may edit a published object or a state file to sign a full pass: the VERIFY consumption — driving source revocation, the two deadlines, target-audience widening, the missed-event full scan, isolation failure and real inaccessible readback against the same-run journey's actually-published knowledge on the live stack — stays execution_owner=VERIFY (pilot-journey/same-run-delivery.journey.json steps 7-11). Recipe validation alone never closes L01-L11.
verdictSemantics.FAIL: the declared construction scope executed and the observed outcome contradicted the frozen THEN (the maintenance run omitted origin_run, the knowledge ids or the operation key, an id-less origin run or a closure-less maintenance was accepted, the delivered history was rewritten or a second currentPhase appeared, a pre-isolation authorization restored the object, the SLA fields or the two timing scales were missing or conflated, the recipe/registration binding drifted, or the case module reported failures)
verdictSemantics.NOT-EXERCISED: a prerequisite was missing (registered recipe, schema-valid definition, frozen pilot baseline, identity or environment); structured refusal with nonzero exit, never converted into a pass
verdictSemantics.NOT-APPLICABLE: explicitly out of scope for the registered profile with a recorded reason; still nonzero; the runner never self-assigns it
